# 51 — Info layers (`data/infoLayer_*.grle`)

GIANTS `GRLE` run-length images. Terrain `<InfoLayer>`s read them for per-region metadata (farmland ownership,
field type, collision/placement masks). Generated by `binfmt.blank_grle`. Format reverse-engineered and byte-
verified.

## Layout
```
Header (21 bytes):
  "GRLE" + version(u8=1) + width,height,imageChannels,payloadSize (u32 LE each)
Payload: row-major run stream. Each run = value V repeated N times:
  N == 1 : a single byte V
  N >= 2 : V, V, 0xFF*k, term   where N = 255*k + term + 2   (k=(N-2)//255, term=(N-2)%255)
Disambiguation: RLE never has two adjacent equal single-pixel runs, so byte[i+1]==byte[i] => the N>=2 form.
```

## Blank map
Every pixel 0 → a single run of value 0 over `width*height` pixels: `0, 0, 0xFF*k, term`. Tiny (~65 KB for 4096²).

## The empty map's info layers (resolution per layer, verified)
| file | resolution | InfoLayer |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| `infoLayer_farmland.grle` | 4096² | `farmlands` (parcel ids) |
| `infoLayer_fieldType.grle` | 4096² | `fieldType` (0=default,1=rice) |
| `infoLayer_indoorMask.grle` | 2048² | `indoorMask` |
| `infoLayer_navigationCollision.grle` | 2048² | `navigationCollision` |
| `infoLayer_tipCollision.grle` | 2048² | `tipCollision` |
| `infoLayer_tipCollisionGenerated.grle` | 2048² | `tipCollisionGenerated` |
| `infoLayer_placementCollision.grle` | 2048² | `placementCollision` |
| `infoLayer_placementCollisionGenerated.grle` | 2048² | `placementCollisionGenerated` |

(`environment` is **not** generated — the terrain InfoLayer points at base-game `$data/maps/mapUS/data/infoLayer_environment.png`.)
All ours are blank (all-zero): no farmland owned, no rice, no collision masks — a truly empty map.

## Generator
```python
binfmt.blank_grle(path, size_px)        # 4096 for farmland/fieldType, 2048 for the collision/mask layers
```
